instruction: Navigate to the about page to learn more about the company.

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Ticketek homepage to the about page. Evaluator checks if the active tab URL contains 'about' pattern.
metadata.verification_notes: Using existing is_expected_url_pattern_match metric. Pattern 'about' will match URLs like '/about-us', '/about', etc.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction - pattern 'about' will match about pages like '/about', '/about-us', etc.
Metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly handles both string URLs and dict with 'url' field from getter
Complete coverage: evaluator checks that active tab URL contains 'about' pattern, which verifies navigation to about page
Minor concern: get_active_tab_info getter reloads the target URL which could cause unexpected behavior if the page has cache/cookie dependencies (though metadata notes this was tested)
Minor concern: No postconfig to ensure Chrome/tab remains accessible, but getter has retry logic and error handling (2 retries with 60s timeout)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to activate Chrome window before evaluation to ensure accessibility tree can read the active tab URL
If the about page has authentication or session requirements, consider using get_active_url_from_accessTree instead of get_active_tab_info to avoid page reload issues
